objective: Learn short-horizon physical movement and combat under explicit planner goals for the state-driven Tail Cave progression stack, with emphasis on the observed room 52 and room 42 combat bottlenecks.

system_boundary.learned: Local movement and A/B action selection from the current structured observation, prior action, current room, and explicit target room/position.
system_boundary.scripted: Quest-stage selection, prerequisite checks, interaction completion, inventory management, target generation, transition verification, and bounded recovery.
system_boundary.failure_contract: The controller returns control to the state-driven recovery layer on budget exhaustion, unexpected room, death, or a failed stage precondition.

learner_data.source: Only independently replay-verified successful trajectories from the frozen teacher panel.
learner_data.split_selection: Fixed before feature extraction or optimizer updates; the last four successful case IDs form the visible learner-development group.
learner_data.label_contract: Replay each source trace from its initial state, capture the complete structured observation before each eligible physical movement/A/B decision, and preserve the demonstrated action and duration. Exclude menu, dialogue-only, transition-settling, and stage-interaction decisions from local-control labels.
learner_data.goal_contract: Each label carries the already selected state-driven waypoint or room transition target. Future-state lookahead and validation outcomes are forbidden inference inputs.
learner_data.focus_room_notation: decimal room IDs corresponding to 0x52 and 0x42

candidate_1.architecture: goal-conditioned two-layer 256-unit MLP compatible with the existing structured navigation observation
candidate_1.initialization: A separate copy of the selected navigation controller; the selected runtime policy remains unchanged.
candidate_1.selection: Final epoch only; no checkpoint shopping.
candidate_1.loss: Movement cross-entropy plus 0.25 button cross-entropy, with parent-retention loss on the first 8192 verified base-cache rows and balanced sampling of rooms 0x52 and 0x42.

development_gate.local_teacher_arrivals: At least 18/20 alive completions on a newly frozen development arrival panel before integrated use.
development_gate.integrated_progression: At least 18/20 on the existing visible house development specifications, with no loss of a previously successful mandatory case.
development_gate.following_interaction: At least 9/10 successful continuous handoffs to the next interaction.
development_gate.replay: Every evaluated episode must independently replay action, state, frame, event journal, and final outcome exactly.

sealed_evaluation.access_policy: Preserve the specifications and completed results as evaluation evidence. Do not load them during feature extraction, training, learner-development selection, or recovery tuning.

integrity.teacher_source_hashes: Frozen in runs/state-driven-teacher-development-v3/panel.json and verified after completion.

next_action: Implement and verify replay-time feature extraction against this frozen contract before the first optimizer update.
